title: HeroForge Autodev Hook Infrastructure
description: Create a Claude Code hook system that automates the game development loop: implement → screenshot → review → next phase, until all phases complete.

stories.title: autodev-loop.sh status checker script
acceptanceCriteria: With .omc/autodev-active present, script exits 0 and outputs NEXT_PHASE/NEXT_SUBPHASE/NEXT_TASK
Without .omc/autodev-active, script exits 1 and outputs AUTODEV_INACTIVE
Script correctly identifies Phase 2 (highest partial phase) as the current focus, not Phase 0
Script finds the correct sub-phase header for the next unchecked item

stories.title: /autodev slash command
acceptanceCriteria: Command describes the 3-step loop: implement → verify (screenshot + review) → next
Command instructs to create .omc/autodev-active state file on start
Command instructs to delete .omc/autodev-active when all phases complete
Command references COVERAGE.md and OPENSPEC_EXECUTION_PLAN.md for task discovery

stories.title: Hook configuration in settings.json
acceptanceCriteria: .claude/settings.json contains PostToolUse hook on TaskUpdate matcher
PostToolUse hook runs autodev-loop.sh and injects continuation context when autodev is active
PostToolUseFailure hook on Bash provides error recovery guidance when autodev is active
Existing PreToolUse hook for Edit|Write is preserved
